description:
Harden the landing-page-business-suite and scenario-to-desktop release contract so LPBS is a reliable commercial distribution surface for desktop apps.

This should cover the concrete contract around:
- app_key and channel handling
- canonical desktop update policy defaults and the seam for per-app override later
- customer-visible update state and release notes surfaces
- artifact promotion and current-version selection
- checksum and sha512 expectations
- update_api_key behavior
- remote-profile readiness and verification
- post-release update endpoint checks
- the LPBS-side guarantees required for generated apps to ship a non-invasive auto-update flow by default

Goal: releases and updates become deterministic, inspectable, and safe to sell through LPBS.
name: lpbs-desktop-release-contract-hardening
title: Harden The LPBS Desktop Release Contract
